article.headline: Knicks and Heat meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.description: Miami Heat (10-7, sixth in the Eastern Conference) vs. New York Knicks (12-6, third in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: Knicks and Heat meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.linkText: Knicks and Heat meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.story: Miami Heat (10-7, sixth in the Eastern Conference) vs. New York Knicks (12-6, third in the Eastern Conference) New York; Friday, 7 p.m. EST LINE: Knicks -4.5; over/under is 224.5 BOTTOM LINE: The Miami Heat visit the Miami Heat in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup. The Knicks are 10-6 in Eastern Conference games. New York is 2-1 in games decided by less than 4 points. The Heat are 5-3 against Eastern Conference opponents. Miami is second in the Eastern Conference with 29.3 assists per game led by Davion Mitchell averaging 8.7. The Knicks are shooting 44.5% from the field this season, 3.1 percentage points lower than the 47.6% the Heat allow to opponents. The Heat average 16.5 more points per game (119.7) than the Knicks give up to opponents (103.2). TOP PERFORMERS: Jalen Brunson is averaging 26.1 points and 5.9 assists for the Knicks. Karl-Anthony Towns is averaging 20.2 points over the last 10 games. Giannis Antetokounmpo is averaging 28.4 points, 12.7 rebounds and 5.4 assists for the Heat. Bam Adebayo is averaging 21.0 points over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Knicks: 8-2, averaging 109.3 points, 45.4 rebounds, 27.9 assists, 6.9 steals and 4.7 blocks per game while shooting 45.8% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 101.6 points per game. Heat: 8-2, averaging 120.8 points, 42.9 rebounds, 29.7 assists, 7.5 steals and 6.0 blocks per game while shooting 47.3% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 115.5 points. INJURIES: Knicks: Jordan Clarkson: day to day (foot), Miles McBride: day to day (adductor), OG Anunoby: day to day (calf). Heat: None listed. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
